params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon {{tip|death|dying}}, {{ci|Kog'Maw}} enters an {{tip|untargetable}} {{tip|zombie state}} for a few seconds, gradually gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. He explodes at the end of the duration, dealing {{as|true damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Kog'Maw''' enters a {{tip|zombie state}} for 4 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that increases up to {{as|50%|MS}} over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes to deal {{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pplevel|140 to 650}} true damage}}}} to nearby enemies.
params.description2: While under this state, '''Kog'Maw''' becomes {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}, but is also rendered unable to declare {{tip|basic attacks}}, cast {{tip|abilities}}, use [[summoner spell]]s, and [[active ability items|activate items]].
params.notes:
* ''Icathian Surprise's'' {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} increases by {{as|{{ap|(50-10)/16}}% |ms}} every {{rutngt|0.25}} over the duration, up to the maximum of {{as|50%|ms}}. However, as a result of the ticks being rounded up from {{fd|0.25}} seconds, the movement speed only reaches up to {{as|{{ap|10+((50-10)/16)*14}}%|ms}}.
* ''Icathian Surprise's'' {{tip|untargetability}} does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}}.
* ''Icathian Surprise'' will still trigger if '''Kog'Maw''' is killed by the {{tip|Nexus Obelisk}}.
* If '''Kog'Maw''' has the missile from a basic attack in-flight at the same time that he's moving while he dies, as long as the missile hits the target after ''Icathian Surprise'' has started, '''Kog'Maw''' will be able to use a basic attack once during ''Icathian Surprise''.
* '''Kog'Maw's''' usable [[summoner spell]]s will be placed on a 5 second cooldown upon becoming a zombie.
* During ''Icathian Surprise'', '''Kog'Maw's''' {{as|{{sti|attack range}}}} is reduced{{ft|to 0|by 500}}, making him automatically path near enemies he is trying to target.
{{Zombie state info}}

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' ejects a wad of spittle in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, reducing their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for a few seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' ejects a wad of spittle in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and reduces their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for 4 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kog'Maw}} empowers his basic attacks for a period, gaining {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}} and dealing {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' empowers his [[basic attack]]s for the next 8 seconds to gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, capped at 100 against {{tip|minion|minions}} and {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Range|{{ap|130 to 210}}}}
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|3 to 6}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
params.notes: * The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against [[structures]].

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kog'Maw}} spews a gob of ooze in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. It leaves a field of ooze in its wake for a few seconds that {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' spews a gob of ooze in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description2: A field of ooze is created in its wake for 3 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* {{pending for test}}: The missile leaves a blob of ooze on the ground every 125 units traveled.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kog'Maw}} spits a globule of acid into the air that drops to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}. The damage is further {{ccs|doubled|magic}} against enemies at {{as|low health}}.
params.blurb2: '''Kog'Maw''' then gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Living Artillery'', stacking up to a cap.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Living Artillery:}} For each stack, ''Living Artillery'' gains increased {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' spits a globule of acid into the air that drops to the target location after {{fd|0.6}} seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area before dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds. ''Living Artillery's'' damage is increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 50 for 11|key1=%|0 to 60|formula=0.833% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 50% increase at 60% '''missing''' health.''}}|health}}, or instead by {{ccs|100%|magic}} if the target is below {{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 180}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35 to 45}}% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|100*2 to 180*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*2 to 45*2}}% AP)}}}}
params.description2: '''Kog'Maw''' then generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Living Artillery'' for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times.
params.description3: {{sbc|Living Artillery:}} For each stack, ''Living Artillery's'' {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is increased by {{as|40|mana}}.
params.notes:
* ''Living Artillery'' will not reveal {{tip|stealth|stealthed}} champions.
* [[Ping]]ing ''Living Artillery'' will additionally display the remaining time duration of its stacks.
